verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is designed to be self-hosted: users run `llama serve`/`llama cli` locally or via Docker, with pre-built binaries, cross-platform hardware support (CPU, Apple Silicon, CUDA/HIP/MUSA), and no external dependencies, and community reports confirm running it fully on personal hardware (M1 Macs, desktop CPUs, GPUs). missing for 10: no first-party production self-hosting/deployment guide (e.g., systemd/k8s hardening) or independent security review of self-hosted setups.
